review: All 24 narration/explanation records read alongside cited NWT 2013 accounts. No independent human acceptance claimed. Existing sourceReview notes remain unchanged.
sensitivity: Dinah is not blamed; violence is not depicted graphically or celebrated. Genesis49 condemnation is identified as later.
chronology: Isaac death is described as a record at the end of Genesis35, not asserted to precede the sale chronologically. Joseph scene order and 37:36 ending retained.
precision: Special robe rather than many-coloured coat; no assertion of minted coins.
Reuben rescue intent distinguished from Judah sale proposal; no invented reason for absence.
Bethel altar and Benjamin names checked with NWT footnotes.
